member_count.description: MemberCount is the number of models an admin chose — see Unrestricted.

unrestricted.description:
Unrestricted carries the same meaning and the same obligation as
ModelSetDTO.Unrestricted: branch on it before rendering MemberCount.

code.description:
Code is the specific machine-readable reason within Type. Optional: a
message-only error omits it.

message.description: Message is the human-readable description, safe to show to the caller.

type.description:
Type is the broad class of the error. Optional: a message-only error
omits it.
